note: Entity Browser - Table Layout ships exactly one field-widget plugin, entity_reference_browser_table_widget (class EntityReferenceBrowserTableWidget), which subclasses entity_browser's EntityReferenceBrowserWidget and renders the current selection as a sortable table. It applies to entity_reference and entity_reference_revisions fields and is chosen per field on Manage form display (stored as the component 'type' in a core.entity_form_display config entity). Its only added setting is additional_fields.options.status (a Status column); all other settings are inherited from Entity Browser. configure=null, no routes/permissions/Drush/plugin types. Medium introspection reads back which Article field uses the widget; hard execution switches a field's form-display widget to the table widget, verified against the live entity_form_display.

evals.prompt: In Drupal, I want a multi-value entity reference field to show its currently selected entities as a sortable table (with drag-to-reorder) instead of Entity Browser's default card grid. Which module provides this, and what is the machine name of the field widget I select on Manage form display?
evals.expected_output: The Entity Browser - Table Layout module (entity_browser_table) provides a field widget whose id is entity_reference_browser_table_widget, labelled 'Entity Browser - Table'. Select it as the widget for the reference field on the bundle's Manage form display.

evals.prompt: Which field types does the entity_browser_table 'Entity Browser - Table' widget support, and which Entity Browser widget class does it extend?
evals.expected_output: It supports entity_reference and entity_reference_revisions fields, and the widget class EntityReferenceBrowserTableWidget extends entity_browser's EntityReferenceBrowserWidget, overriding only how the current selection is displayed (a table).

evals.prompt: The entity_browser_table widget can add an extra 'Status' column to its table. Which widget setting enables it, and what does the column show?
evals.expected_output: Tick the widget's 'Additional Fields' checkbox (setting additional_fields.options.status). The Status column shows the entity's Content Moderation state when the entity is moderated, otherwise Published/Unpublished derived from the status field.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has one entity reference field configured to display its selected entities as a table using the entity_browser_table widget. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_ebt_refs: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component uses widget type entity_reference_browser_table_widget.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a multi-value entity reference field field_ebt_task whose default form-display widget is the plain autocomplete. Using the entity_browser_table module, change the default form display so this field is edited with the 'Entity Browser - Table' widget. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_ebt_task component's widget type is set to entity_reference_browser_table_widget (e.g. load the entity_form_display, change the component type and save, or select 'Entity Browser - Table' on Manage form display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity reference field that uses the entity_browser_table widget with the extra 'Status' column enabled. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_ebt_stat: its entity_reference_browser_table_widget component has settings.additional_fields.options.status set (truthy) in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field field_ebt_task2 already using the 'Entity Browser - Table' widget, but its extra Status column is off. Turn on the Status column for that field's widget so the table shows each referenced entity's status/moderation state. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_ebt_task2 widget's settings.additional_fields.options.status is set truthy (e.g. tick 'Additional Fields' on the widget, or set the component setting and save).
